title: deotte-te-income
hypothesis: Fold-safe smoothed target encoding of the exact Annual_Income_USD value, added to all three Deotte XGBs on top of --freq, lifts blend CV by >= 0.0001.
rationale: Queue items 1-3 are killed (ensemble saturated: +0.00000..+0.00003). Item 5 (TE) never got a CV score - it timed out twice on oversized plans, so retry with a minimal plan. Read-only EDA shows 68% of rows carry an income value with count >= 100, and those spike values have value-specific target rates that are not smooth in income (68480 -> 0.270, 65800 -> 0.065, 72441 -> 0.036, 131789 -> 0.353). --freq only flags 'is a spike'; hist XGB with 256 bins cannot isolate 14.6k exact values. TE gives trees the per-value rate directly. Income only; commute spike rates are flat (0.14-0.19).
one_change: Add --te flag: extra column Annual_Income_USD_te = smoothed (m=20) target mean per exact income value; train rows use nested 5-fold OOF TE inside the outer train fold, val/test rows use the map fit on the whole outer train fold (stored on each fold model as te_map_).
code_instructions: features.py: add te_fit/te_apply/te_oof helpers + TE_COL, FeatureBuilder(freq, te) attr. deotte.py: in _fit_fold, if fb.te add Annual_Income_USD_te (te_oof for x_tr, te_apply with full-fold map for x_va, stash m.te_map_=(mp,prior)); _predict_variant applies each model's te_map_; thread te kwarg run_cv/train -> FeatureBuilder(freq=freq, te=te). __main__.py: --te flag, pass te=args.te. Smoke with --synth. Details in NEXT_STRATEGY.md.

notes_md:
# exp0010 — deotte-te-income

**Parent:** exp0001 (CV 0.94333 ± 0.00070)

**Hypothesis:** Fold-safe smoothed target encoding (m=20) of the exact `Annual_Income_USD`
value, added to all three Deotte XGBs on top of `--freq`, lifts blend CV by >= 0.0001.
Income spike values (count 600-1000 each; 68 % of rows have count >= 100) carry
value-specific target rates that are not smooth in income (68480 -> 0.270, 65800 -> 0.065,
72441 -> 0.036, 131789 -> 0.353). `--freq` only flags a spike; 256-bin hist XGB cannot
isolate 14.6k exact values.

**Change:** new `--te` flag -> column `Annual_Income_USD_te`. Train rows: nested 5-fold
OOF TE inside the outer train fold; val/test rows: map fit on the whole outer train fold
(stored per fold model as `te_map_`). XGB params, folds (5, seed 42), recipe,
base_margin and 1/3 blend unchanged.
executor_checklist: features.py: add TE_COL, te_fit, te_apply, te_oof; FeatureBuilder(freq=False, te=False) sets self.te
deotte.py: _fit_fold adds Annual_Income_USD_te (te_oof for train, te_apply for val) and sets m.te_map_ when fb.te
deotte.py: _predict_variant transforms per model and applies m.te_map_ when fb.te
deotte.py: run_cv/train accept te kwarg; FeatureBuilder(freq=freq, te=te)
__main__.py: add --te flag, pass te=args.te to train_deotte
Write exps/exp0010/config.json and NOTES.md from iteration_plan.json
Smoke: python -m ev_s6e9 train --strategy deotte --freq --te --synth --no-log && python -m ev_s6e9 predict --strategy deotte
Do not change folds/seed/metric/XGB params; do not fit TE on validation rows
